name: Antas (Spain)
description: Orange field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Antas (letters F Y on blue beside a tree on green, above waves).
history: Antas was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía to adopt its symbols in July 1998 but did not do so until July 2007; the flag is a rectangular orange cloth of proportions 1:2 with the municipal arms at the centre, half the width of the flag in height.

features.role: Antas arms — letters F Y, tree and waves
